title: US sanctions Cuban oil shipping and military-support networks
note: The US State Department designates eight entities and two individuals and identifies five vessels as blocked property, targeting Cuba's oil shipping, state import entities and China-based technical support. It tightens economic pressure on Havana and on the foreign suppliers of its military equipment.

title: US first lady hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials, urges a lasting truce
note: Both sides credit the US first lady with a key but unspecified role in a local Russia-Ukraine ceasefire, and she calls for lasting peace. Local truces have repeatedly collapsed, so this matters mainly as a channel for wider talks.

title: Bank of England raises rates for the first time since 2023 on energy inflation
note: Policymakers say inflation pressure from months of high energy prices required a rise now, and warn more is likely. It shows how the Hormuz-linked energy shock is feeding into European monetary conditions.

title: Indonesia mobilizes thousands of troops amid a widening rift among top leaders
note: The deployment of thousands of military personnel this week has fed speculation about a split between the current president and his predecessor, after a wiretap spilled the rivalry into public. It bears on the stability of Southeast Asia's largest state.

title: Attacks on water and sanitation in war zones more than triple since 2021
note: UN reporting says attacks that damaged or destroyed water and sanitation systems in conflict zones tripled between 2021 and 2025. This raises children's risk of disease outbreaks, malnutrition and violence.
